item.title: Fire crews save house after explosion, fire in West Kelowna
item.description: VICTORIA — Firefighters in West Kelowna, B.C., say they managed to save a house from flames early Sunday morning following reports of an explosion.

item.title: Syrian government announces a ceasefire with the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces
item.description: RAQQA, Syria (AP) — The Syrian government Sunday announced a ceasefire with the Syrian Democratic Forces, taking almost full control of the country and dismantling the Kurdish-led forces that controlled the northeast for over a decade.

item.title: Senegal wins Africa Cup of Nations after chaotic final against host Morocco
item.description: RABAT, Morocco (AP) — Senegal has won the Africa Cup of Nations in dramatic fashion.

item.title: Kaltounková and Cherkowski score goals, Osborne has 31 saves as Sirens beat Victoire 2-1
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Kristýna Kaltounková and Anne Cherkowski each scored a goal, Kayle Osborne had 31 saves and the New York Sirens beat the Montreal Victoire 2-1 on Sunday at Capital One Arena as part of the PWHL’s Takeover Tour .

item.title: High-speed trains collide after one derails in southern Spain, killing at least 10 people
item.description: MADRID (AP) — A high-speed train crash in southern Spain on Sunday killed at least 10 people, the Guardia Civil said. Two Guardia Civil officials confirmed the death toll to The Associated Press by phone and text message.

item.title: Somali businesses struggle during the Minneapolis ICE crackdown
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — Rows of businesses stood shuttered inside a sprawling complex of Somali businesses on a recent afternoon.
